changelog:
Add local file support and video enhancements. Major feature additions:

- Local file/folder support: Can now process local files and directories with automatic type detection (video, audio, image, text, subtitle)
- Video enhancements: Add beautify, sharpen, and resolution upscale filters with real-time preview
- Seek thumbnail preview: YouTube-style hover preview on video seek bar
- UI improvements: Window positioning presets, alignment snapping, image search/filtering
- HEIC/HEIF support: Auto-convert HEIC images to JPEG via pillow-heif
- Enhanced playback: Episode navigation buttons, autoplay next episode, improved format grouping
- Local file proxying: Serve local files through Flask endpoints with proper MIME types
